correctness.rationale: The first t−1 draws contain all and only the labels other than i; positive occupancy counts give the exact marked mass by the multinomial formula. The coefficient sequences p^k/k! on k≥1 are log-concave with interval support. Consecutive-ratio comparison (or the automatic boundary case when the off-diagonal product vanishes) gives nonnegative 2×2 Toeplitz minors, preserved under convolution by finite Cauchy–Binet. For w=t−1<v=u−1 the determinant of the two convolution rows has the paired expansion (3). Its input determinants are positive since (p_i/p_j)^k increases, and its kernel determinants are nonnegative. For m≥3, s=m−2 is the first positive index of g. The summand k=w−s, l=k+1 has g_(w−k)>0, g_(w−l)=0 and g_(v−l)>0, ensuring strictness. For m=2, take k=w,l=v in the point-mass kernel. Positive conditional normalizations do not change the comparison; equal weights give identical rows by swapping labels and unequal weights force strictness. All comparisons are on the common positive support t≥m.
residual_risks: Finite computations corroborate the coefficient and sign conventions; the Toeplitz proof and boundary witnesses establish the unbounded result. The domain excludes null draws and unequal quotas, and is discrete iid sampling with strictly positive normalized probabilities.
